UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a player's profile in the game, holding personal data, currency, and references to their owned heroes and teams.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

inGameCurrency.description: The amount of in-game currency the player possesses.

experiencePoints.description: The total experience points accumulated by the player.

lastLoginDate.description: Timestamp of the player's last login.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

ownedHeroIds.description: References to heroes owned by this player.

leagueRankingId.description: Reference to the player's current league ranking.

leagueLevel.description: The level in the pyramid (1 is highest).

divisionSubId.description: Sub-division ID at the current level.

selectedLeagueId.description: The ID of the league window selected by the player.

Hero.title: Hero
Hero.description: Defines a MOBA hero character with their base statistics, role, and abilities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Hero entity.

description.description: A brief description or lore of the hero.

role.description: The primary intrinsic role of the hero (e.g., 'Carry', 'Support', 'Tank').

rarity.description: The rarity level of the hero (e.g., 'Common', 'Rare', 'Epic', 'Legendary').

baseAbilityPower.description: The hero's base ability power for magical damage or healing.

abilityNames.description: A list of the hero's primary ability names.

imageUrl.description: URL to the hero's portrait or icon image.

PlayerTeam.title: PlayerTeam
PlayerTeam.description: Represents a team of heroes managed by a player for competitive play.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PlayerTeam entity.

name.description: The name of the player's team.

description.description: A short description of the team or its motto.

userProfileId.description: Reference to the UserProfile that owns this team.

rosterSlotIds.description: References to the TeamRosterSlots that compose this team's lineup.

strategyId.description: Reference to the strategy assigned to this team.

TeamRosterSlot.title: TeamRosterSlot
TeamRosterSlot.description: Represents a specific hero assigned to a slot within a player's team.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TeamRosterSlot entity.

playerTeamId.description: Reference to the PlayerTeam this roster slot belongs to.

heroId.description: Reference to the Hero assigned to this slot.

assignedRole.description: The specific lane or position role assigned to this hero.

level.description: The current level of the hero.

experience.description: The experience points accumulated by this hero.

Strategy.title: Strategy
Strategy.description: Defines a pre-configured strategy or tactical approach for a player's team.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Strategy entity.

name.description: A descriptive name for the strategy.

tacticsType.description: General type of tactics employed by this strategy.

focusPoints.description: Key areas or phases of the game this strategy emphasizes.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user.
